scope: Read-only S version guidance and fixed rerun plan audit. No tests, Unity, provider calls or credential reads.

wordingNotes.observation: The reviewed plan says 48 new provider attempts, but the runner caps admitted decision requests at 48 before proxy validation. Pre-provider failure may yield fewer actual provider attempts.
wordingNotes.recommendation: State 48 preregistered samples and at most 48 new provider attempts; retain failures and report actual counts without replacement.

comparabilityLimits: The S prompt grows by 404 UTF-8 bytes. Token usage and latency comparisons include this prompt-length change; no token count was estimated here.
New F/S contexts should match after removing expression.mode within this run. New world identities mean historical context bytes need not match.
A new F/S run without a simultaneous old-S arm cannot isolate the prompt edit as the sole cause of a measured change.
Fixed probes do not establish moving-world conversation stability or long-term zero error rates.
conclusion: No blocking issue found in the reviewed production diff or the fixed-only experiment design. Model outcome remains unmeasured by this review.
